info.title: Squally Read API
info.description:
Read access to a Squally organization's test results, for scripts, CI jobs and AI agents.

**Authentication.** Every request carries an organization read key as `Authorization: Bearer sqly_ro_…`. A read key is organization-wide (every project), created by an organization admin in Settings → API keys, and expires after 30, 60, 90, 180 days as chosen at creation. There is no renewal: create a new key and revoke the old one. Project ingest keys (`sqly_…`) are refused with `wrong_key_type`.

**Expiry warning.** From 7 days before a key expires, every authenticated response carries `Squally-Key-Expires-At` with the expiry instant (ISO-8601).

**Rate limit.** Currently 60 requests per 60 seconds per key, counted per `Authorization` header - a read key has its own budget, shared with nothing else. Over the limit the edge answers 429 without a JSON body.

**Retries.** 429: wait 60 seconds, then retry. The edge counts requests per key in 60-second windows and sends no Retry-After header. 5xx: retry with exponential backoff, starting at 1 second and capped at 30 seconds. 400, 401, 403, 404: never retry - the same request gets the same answer.

**Plans.** The read API is part of the Standard and Pro plans. A key of an organization on Free is answered 403 `tier_too_low`; keys are not revoked on a downgrade and work again after an upgrade.

**Errors.** Every error is `{"error": "<sentence>", "code": "<slug>"}`. The sentence may be reworded; the slug may not. An id that does not exist and an id that belongs to another organization get the same 404, byte for byte.

**Test names in paths.** Test names are Playwright title paths and often contain `/`: URL-encode them, including `/` as `%2F`.

**Sharded runs** are returned as one logical run: /runs lists one row per logical run, and the run routes answer for all shards whichever shard's id you pass.

**Stability.** v1, beta. The API may change until the beta ends; every change is listed in the changelog (docs/openapi/CHANGELOG.md).

get.description: Every test with a CI run in the period and its metrics - stability, flaky rate, failure rate, runs, time lost, its last 20 runs, the branches it ran on and where it fails most - ranked by the chosen sort. Counts completed CI runs only, without mass-failure runs, on every branch unless branch names one (see population). Moderate: two queries over the period's CI results, paged in the database; use the metrics route for one test.

parameters.name: projectId
parameters.description: A project id from GET /projects.

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: The period, in days, ending now. Must not exceed the plan's retention (Standard 60, Pro 90 days); a longer period is refused with 400 invalid_period rather than answered with less data.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring of the test name or its file.

parameters.name: branch
parameters.description: Only runs on this branch, the name exactly. Every branch when absent.

parameters.name: browser
parameters.description: Only tests of this Playwright project - the items' browser field, exactly (e.g. chromium). Every test when absent.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Ranking, the worst first: stability (the default) lowest first; flakyRate, failureRate, runs and timeLost highest first. Ties go to the most runs (for runs: the lowest stability), then to the test name and file. A rate with nothing to divide by (null) sorts after every number.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: 1-based page number. A page past the end answers the last page.

parameters.name: perPage
parameters.description: Rows per page, 1 to 100.

readKey.description: An organization read key (sqly_ro_…), created by an organization admin in Settings → API keys. Expires after 30, 60, 90, 180 days; no renewal.

Squally-Key-Expires-At.description: When the read key expires (ISO-8601). Present only from 7 days before expiry.

flaky.description: Tests whose final attempt passed after at least one retry in this run. Not counted in passed: total = passed + failed + skipped + flaky.

nextCursor.description: Pass as ?cursor= for the next page of older runs; null on the last page.

prevCursor.description: Pass as ?cursor= with direction=prev for newer runs; null on the first page.

flaky.description: Tests whose final attempt passed after at least one retry in this run. Not counted in passed: total = passed + failed + skipped + flaky.

copyPrompt.description: A prompt for an assistant that has the repository open, byte-identical to the Copy for AI button. null for an attempt without a real failure (a pass, a test.fail() marker, no error text).

population.description: Which runs every number counts: completed CI runs (reported with a CI provider) started inside the period, without the runs excluded as a mass failure (at least 20 tests, over 80% of them failed). Every branch unless the branch parameter names one. Local runs never count.

days.description: The period in days, ending at until.

since.description: Start of the period: until minus days. ISO-8601.

until.description: End of the period: when the numbers were computed. ISO-8601.

branch.description: The branch filter applied; null for every branch.

browser.description: The browser filter applied; null for every test.

total.description: Tests matching the query across all pages: every test with at least one CI run in the period, narrowed by search, branch and browser.

testName.description: The stored name: Playwright's title path, the Playwright project first when there is one. The identity other test routes take.

browser.description: The Playwright project the name starts with (chromium in "chromium > cart.spec.ts > adds an item") - null when the name has none, i.e. when its second part is not the test's own file.

runs.description: CI runs in the period in which the test has a final attempt that did not skip: stableRuns + flakyRuns + failedRuns.

stableRuns.description: Of runs, those whose final attempt passed on the first try.

flakyRuns.description: Of runs, those whose final attempt passed after at least one retry.

failedRuns.description: Of runs, those whose final attempt failed.

stability.description: stableRuns / runs, a fraction from 0 to 1. null only when runs is 0.

flakyRate.description: flakyRuns / runs, a fraction from 0 to 1. null only when runs is 0.

failureRate.description: failedRuns / runs, a fraction from 0 to 1. null only when runs is 0.

timeLostMs.description: Time spent on attempts that did not count, in ms, summed over runs: a failed run loses every attempt it made, a run rescued by a retry the attempts before the pass, each at the final attempt's duration. 0 when every run passed on the first try.

branch.description: The run's branch; null when its CI sent none.

result.description: The run's final attempt: stable (passed on the first try), flaky (passed after at least one retry), failed, or skipped. A skipped run appears only here: it is not a run of the test, so it counts in neither runs nor any rate.

recentResults.description: The test's last 20 runs in the period, oldest first, including runs whose final attempt skipped (result skipped). Empty when it has none.

branches.description: Every branch the test ran on in the period, code-point order, a null branch (a run whose CI sent none) last.

topBranch.description: The branch with the most failed runs (kind failures, count = those runs); when no run failed, the branch with the most flaky runs (kind retries, count = those runs); null when neither. Ties go to the branch name in code-point order, a null branch last.

windowEmpty.description: True when the signature did not occur in the requested period; the figures then cover everything still stored.

runsInWindow.description: Completed CI runs in the window on branchScope, without mass-failure runs - the runs windowStability is counted over.

windowStability.description: Suite stability, 0-100: of the final test results in the window's completed CI runs on branchScope (mass-failure runs and skipped results left out), the share that passed on the first try, rounded. A result that passed only after a retry counts against it. null when no such result exists.

failingTests.description: Tests that failed at least once in the window on branchScope, out of the tests those runs reported - every run, local ones included. Not the dashboard's Failing tests tile: that is testMetrics.failingTests, over CI runs on every branch.

population.description: Which runs every number counts: completed CI runs (reported with a CI provider) started inside the period, without the runs excluded as a mass failure (at least 20 tests, over 80% of them failed). Every branch unless the branch parameter names one. Local runs never count.

days.description: The period in days: the same as window.days.

testsWithRetries.description: Of ciTests, the tests with at least one flaky run in the period (a final attempt that passed after a retry).

failingTests.description: Of ciTests, the tests with at least one failed run in the period.

ciTests.description: Tests with at least one CI run in the period.

testMetrics.description: The dashboard's Tests with retries and Failing tests tiles and their denominator, counted like /tests: CI runs only, every branch - not narrowed by branchScope. The top-level failingTests counts differently: every run in the window on branchScope, local ones included.
